subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Building Global Risk Resilience
description: A quick, practical guide to Building Global Risk Resilience.

hook.text: You can't predict the next crisis. But you can build an organization that survives whatever comes.

buildup.text: Global risk resilience combines diversification, scenario planning, strong governance, and adaptive culture.

discovery.text: Companies that invested in resilience before COVID recovered 2x faster than those that hadn't.

twist.text: Resilience costs money in good times. That's why most companies underinvest until disaster proves them wrong.

climax.text: The world is getting riskier. Companies that build resilience now will outlast those that don't.

punchline.text: Can't predict the crisis. Can build resilience. Start now.

quiz.question: How did resilient companies perform during COVID?
options: They recovered 2x faster than non-resilient companies
They performed the same as everyone else
They were hurt more because resilience is costly
